description:
List published tokenized assets.

Call this to find an asset by ticker, name, category, chain, or issuer before get_asset. Live assets are the galactic.inc screener universe. Announced listings have a launch date and no supply, price, or holders.

JSON shape: {"matched", "offset", "limit", "assets": [cards], "upcoming": [cards]}. A card includes id, ticker, display_ticker, name, category, category_label, chains, chain_ids, and status. Figures appear only when their check passed: supply (token supply), price_usd and market_cap_usd (US dollars), holders (address count), top10_share (fraction of supply from 0 to 1), change_1d_percent, change_7d_percent, change_30d_percent, supply_change_30d_percent, volume_30d_usd (US dollars), transfers_30d. Price and market cap require an on-chain price check that passed. Holders require balances that reconcile. Issuer is omitted when the issuer did not resolve. Omitted fields are unpublished, not zero. as_of is the asset's data time in UTC.

category.description: Category slug or English label, such as gold or Treasuries. Empty means every category. Slugs: gold, treasuries, money-market, private-credit, stocks, commodities, funds, real-estate, deposit-token.

chain.description: Chain id (ethereum, solana, robinhood, liquid, zksync, and the other published chain ids) or the chain display name. Empty means every chain.

include_upcoming.description: When true, announced listings with no on-chain figures are included after the live page.

issuer.description: Case-insensitive substring of the published issuer name.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of ticker, display ticker, name, issuer, or id. Empty lists the universe.

response_format.description: markdown (default) is a compact reading form. json is the object described below, with source numbers and omitted fields left out.

name: list_assets
